title: A box for four
logline: Friday. Four stacks into a box. One stays out — THE RIDGE. The box on the shelf beside Box 5. The lid, in marker: BOX 6 · FOUR BOOKS · NO. The arc ends on a lid.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD lowering four stacks into a cardboard box. THE RIDGE on the table, alone. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man lowering four stacks of typed pages into a cardboard box while a fifth stack sits alone on a table, a small dog

panels.composition: The lid. Marker. BOX 6 · FOUR BOOKS · NO.

image.notes: Letter after: BOX 6 · FOUR BOOKS · NO. (The box register.)

panels.composition: The box on the shelf beside Box 5 — NONE OF IT RAN. Two boxes. Two lids. Two kinds of no.

panels.composition: Wood at the table with THE RIDGE. Page one. The pen. The dog's chin on his foot. The strip lets him start again, and doesn't watch.
